entities.summary: Ricardo Ramírez, C.S.B. is an American Catholic prelate who served as the first bishop of Las Cruces in New Mexico from 1982 to 2013. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of San Antonio in Texas from 1981 to 1982. He is a member of the Congregation of St. Basil (Basilians).
